title: I Let the Air-Compressor Gauge Catch the Member Who Returned It at Zero

parts.text: I lifted the hose at 6:22 p.m. and the gauge sat at zero with a wet hiss. Member Glyn had just racked it. The sign said: RETURN AT NINETY. DRAIN THE TANK. LOG THE PSI. I was twenty-four, shop user, holding a log card. I photographed the gauge, the sign, and Glyn's name last on the sheet. Glyn filled it to ninety after the photo. The hose finally looks like a sign, not a sigh. I have learned the difference between a title and a line item.
